reason: Upstream describes eligibility in prose and leaves a commented entry format. S.5.2 states the criteria as a gate — a fact is admitted only when it is at once global, critical, stable, non-derivable and has no more precise canonical owner — and names where a rejected fact goes instead. The routing of an unavailable MCP server is already adapted for the same reason in memory-fallback (S.9.2): an unreachable server must not quietly harden working context into long-term memory. The anchor is the whole upstream file, so a changed criterion upstream stops the build instead of silently widening ours.

This file is the working project memory for AI agents.

Eligibility, routing between this file and `1c-templates-mcp` (`remember` / `recall`),
fallback when the MCP server is unavailable — see `AGENTS.md → Project memory`.
There are no permanent entries yet.
